questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw white cabbage are harvested across all commercial agricultural farms in Poland in a single year?
reasoning: Poland harvests roughly 1 million tonnes of white cabbage annually
One tonne is equal to one thousand kilograms
Multiplying 1 million tonnes by 1000 gives 900 million kilograms accounting for recent yield estimates

questions.prompt: How many total individual sheets of paper are consumed by all university students enrolled in higher education degree programs across Australia in a single academic year?
reasoning: Australia has approximately 1.5 million university students
Each student uses an average of 250 sheets of printed or notebook paper per academic year
Multiplying 1.5 million students by 250 sheets yields 375 million total sheets

questions.prompt: How many total individual metal paper clips are manufactured by all stationery factories operating in Japan in a single year?
reasoning: Japan has a corporate workforce and student population of roughly 60 million active office and school desk users
Each person consumes an average of 75 paper clips annually for binding documents
Multiplying 60 million people by 75 paper clips yields 4.5 billion manufactured units
